decisions.reason: The net price display plugin is cheap to maintain and close to the core shop offer, and the firm committed to it publicly, so although it has not appeared on the website since 2019, management is likely to keep it in the portfolio.

The ERP interface plugin took substantial development investment and is central to the announced multichannel integration direction, so management will persist with it despite its reduced website visibility.

This price comparison tracking plugin still fits the measurable-marketing positioning, and keeping it justifies the earlier investment in the price comparison line, though its absence from the website since 2019 raises doubts.

This plugin overlaps with Product C, a sibling price comparison plugin (E) was already withdrawn, and it has not appeared on the website for two years, so the initial results can no longer be blamed on the short time since launch and consolidation is the sensible step.
